div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER boxes are the main agent: one memory for the whole run.
Every AGENT box is a new agent with an empty memory.
It knows only what the stage script hands it
and what is on disk, on GitHub, in Sanity, on Basecamp.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Start: Ovi types /page-draft

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER: take the page
Find the page's Basecamp card.
If nobody else has it, mark it in progress
with this branch name

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
my claim comment is first,
card in Building?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Stop. Touch nothing.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
has the plan for this page
already been written?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AGENT: research A
Who the page is for
and the writing rules

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AGENT: research B
What the old page says

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: research C
Related blog posts and
the pages next to it in the menu

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AGENT: research D
Which page sections exist
and the design rules

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AGENT: research E
Which photos exist

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
five sets of notes,
none empty?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER: write the plan
From the notes in memory.
Save it as a GitHub issue,
link it on the card

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: second reader (session model, medium effort)
Reads the plan as the parent
it is written for, lists problems.
A new agent each round

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
found problems?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER: fix the plan
Applies the fixes to the issue

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
more than 8 problems,
and only one round so far?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER: read the plan
Reads the existing plan into memory

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: get ready (sonnet)
Get the latest code,
check nobody else is editing the same sections,
back up the content database

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SCRIPT checks:
latest code pulled,
backup made and checked?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: build one section (session model)
A new agent for each new or redesigned section,
one after the other. None of them sees
what the one before it did, only its files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: write the page text (session model)
Gets the research notes and the plan.
Write the text and save it
as a draft in Sanity

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: proofread (session model, medium effort)
Gets the notes on who the page is for.
Unconfirmed facts, broken sentences, banned words,
colours alternate, buttons in place.
A new agent each round

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SCRIPT checks:
found problems?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AGENT: fix (session model)
Fix them and save again.
A new agent each round

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SCRIPT checks:
more than 8 problems,
and only one round so far?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: load the page (sonnet, low effort)
Load the page on the dev server,
check the draft's headings show up.
One try, no fixer

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SCRIPT checks:
page loads?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT: push the code (sonnet)
Final checks, then push

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage returns: failed,
which step, why, notes for Ovi so far

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
small, plain cause?

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER: give up
Writes what went wrong on the card,
leaves it in Building

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER checks:
push landed, draft has
every planned section, page loaded?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVERSEER: hand over
Move the card to Ovi Polish.
Write on the card: what to look at, what was guessed,
what to ask the camp.
Make the to-do list of things the camp must supply

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Draft ready for Ovi
